# Fix validation errors

- Read the actual command output before making changes.
- Inspect PROJECT_MANIFEST.md, CURRENT_STATUS.md, ROADMAP.md, and the relevant package files to confirm the current scope.
- Fix only the root causes related to the current package or change set.
- Do not suppress Ruff or MyPy errors without explicit permission.
- Re-run the complete validation sequence after the fix.
- Do not commit or push changes.
